title: Symmetric monotone functions are equal weight thresholds
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\\{−1,1\\}$. The function is invariant under every permutation of its input coordinates and is monotone in the coordinatewise order if and only if there is a real number $a_0$ such that, for every input $x$, $f(x)$ is $1$ when $a_0+\\sum_{i=1}^n x_i\\ge 0$ and $-1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to $\\{−1,1\\}$
